text:
Priya: quick notes from Seedly onboarding call — they dropped 4 asks and a renewal watch flag. pasting highlights.
Ethan: can you list the highest-priority items we should triage?
Priya: top items: 1) product search returns vendor/display names but not canonical SKUs (breaks downstream match) 2) they want per-team quota controls + admin UI 3) billing examples in docs confused them — they thought quotas applied account-wide 4) onboarding Console shows a 401 for role-scoped API calls sometimes. also one ask: better example for `batch_index` CLI usage.
Lina: for #1 any tiny repro? one query + response helps.
Priya: pasted snippet & meeting link: https://app.redwood/meetings/seedly-2026-07-14/transcript 
Priya: ```
query: "sku for BlueCap 7"
response: "BlueCap 7 by CapMakers"  // expected token: SKU-BC7-0012 in response
```
Jordan: tagging eng-search. if it's a prompt/preproc issue we can patch quickly; if model output distribution then might need a model prompt-tuning or reroute.
Ethan: docs change seems trivial — I can open a PR to clarify per-route vs account quotas and update the `batch_index` example.
Priya: CSM noted renewal review in 8 weeks; marking as "watch" — they said admin + quota controls are a gating feature. tagging `renewal-watch`.
Lina: for the 401 on role-scoped calls can you paste the exact error body? small error string change could unblock them.
Priya: example 401: `{"error":"unauthorized","detail":"missing_role:team_admin"}` — customer expected guidance text.
Jordan: action items: (1) Jordan reproduce SKU repro + initial guess (owner: Jordan) (2) Ethan docs PR + examples (owner: Ethan) (3) Priya create feature backlog item for team quotas + admin UI (owner: Priya) (4) Lina repro 401 and propose clearer error message (owner: Lina).
Priya: created FEED-11222 and attached notes: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-11222 — please add labels `onboarding`, `search`, `rbac`, `billing`.
cs-bot: FEED-11222 created and linked to customer Seedly. Priority: P2.
Ethan: aiming to push docs canary today. Jordan: can you triage and post a short update by EOD tomorrow?
Jordan: will repro today and post logs here. if it's preproc, expect a 3-5 day fix; model path might be 2+ weeks.
Priya: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll follow up with Seedly CSM with a suggested interim: include SKU hints in prompt + a small post-process regex to extract SKU-like tokens. I'll capture acceptance criteria.
